name: s81su_swtl_ref-v2-noouthold-13223932b
purpose: SW tap, low half-tap: slots 0-7 (4,096 b, pin flop + output flop) + the tap control (job, pass counters, tag, route weight, lim, obase, status, lane-fault relay); replaces dsfd_su_t_swt with dsfd_su_t_swth; lockstep-exact against ot_s81_su_swt delayed one cycle | v2: v1 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116 (H overflow only in a 1.2-um band at x 26.2-27.4 over the whole height, nets e_d* / ot_outhold_*: kit recipe 2 put the 3-cell output hold stage of all 4,096 outputs FIRM at one x on a face with 10.4 b/um, so the legalised chains zigzag: 4 crossings a bit, ~47 H wires/um against 18 a gcell). v2: outhold off -- the output flop sits at its pin in the 4-column pin-flop array (flop -> pin a few um); the hold margin of the outgoing hop is the receiver's input hold stage (every SU tile input keeps its HB4 pair); inputs unchanged (in-hold pair + pin flop FIRM at the W face, no marker there in v1).

structural_change: the single 572.4 x 453.6 tap (v1 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN pin density 20 b/um, v2 EARLY_FAIL_DRC: 473 of the last violations in one 60 x 60 um bin where the control cluster collapsed, clock insertion 614-740 ps) is replaced by TWO half-taps, each a 36.72 x 453.6 column with its own clock root and 4,096 straight M4 bit tracks W -> E; RTL split ot_s81_su_swtl (slots 0-7 + control) / ot_s81_su_swth (slots 8-15), every input pin on its own flop and every output a flop (one cycle deeper)
